segments.text: You have not spent your savings, but you may have promised them twice to different goals today.
Open your savings plan notebook to identify the emergency reserve and name one specific future purchase goal clearly.
Inspect the single balance to locate any portion currently counted for both purposes simultaneously right now.
Assigning the same funds to two competing claims reduces availability for one purpose if an emergency occurs unexpectedly.
Decide which plan changes if the reserve is used, then review the impact on your future-goal timeline immediately.
Follow Wealth Blueprint. Build wealth on purpose.
